name: Suggested (formerly Makerkit)
description_en:
Suggested, formerly Makerkit, is a hosted customer-feedback and feature-request service. It provides a portal for suggestions and votes, a status-based roadmap, and a changelog for announcing shipped changes. The official rebrand announcement establishes the connection to the old Makerkit record; the original catalog slug is retained.

Its useful unit is a customer request with context and supporters. A product team can review that request, communicate a decision and announce a release. That workflow should not be confused with project execution: a roadmap status alone does not demonstrate dependencies, resource planning or delivery verification. This documentation-based profile has not tested a live portal.
description_zh:
Suggested 原名 Makerkit，是托管式客户反馈和功能请求服务，提供建议与投票门户、基于状态的路线图，以及发布产品更新的变更日志。官方更名公告确立了它与旧 Makerkit 档案的关系，本目录保留原有 slug。

它的核心对象是带背景和支持者的客户请求。产品团队可以审阅请求、沟通决定并发布上线公告。这条流程不能直接等同于项目执行：路线图状态本身不能证明依赖管理、资源规划或交付验证能力。本文依据文档编写，未测试真实门户。

review_notes: English and Chinese were checked against the sources attached to each section. Editorial examples and selection judgments are not customer evidence.
Read_at is retrieval time; public-reader text may be cached and does not establish vendor update time.
Draft documentation research only. Independent review, hands-on testing, owner verification and publishing approval remain separate.

sections.title_en: Follow the official rebrand to the right product
sections.title_zh: 沿官方更名记录找到正确产品
sections.en:
The official blog explicitly says Makerkit was rebranded to Suggested. It also states an intention to keep old custom-domain targets and public subdomains working. This is identity evidence, not a test of each old customer portal. No rebrand date is asserted here.

Evaluate the customer-feedback product at suggested.co. Do not transfer features or licenses from similarly named software to this record. The original project-management category is retained as catalog context, while the documented scope here is request collection and product communication.
sections.zh:
官方博客明确说明 Makerkit 更名为 Suggested，并表示计划继续支持旧自定义域名指向和公开子域名。这是产品身份依据，不是对每个旧客户门户的可用性测试。本文不推断更名日期。

应评估 suggested.co 的客户反馈产品，不能把其他同名软件的功能或许可证移入此档案。目录保留原项目管理分类作为背景，本文核实的范围则是请求收集与产品沟通。

sections.title_en: Use a request to test the full communication loop
sections.title_zh: 用一项请求检验完整沟通链
sections.en:
For a hypothetical CSV-export request, record the user’s problem, requested fields and intended use before asking others to vote. Decide whether the portal should accept public submissions or let only the team create feedback while users still vote and comment.

Compare votes with the request’s context and the customers represented; a vote count is a signal, not a representative survey or a development commitment. Assign a team member to review incoming material and explain the decision. This is a proposed evaluation, not an observed customer outcome.
sections.zh:
假设用户请求 CSV 导出，可以先记录问题、所需字段和使用目的，再让其他人投票。应决定门户允许公众提交，还是只让团队创建反馈、用户仍可投票和评论。

票数应结合请求背景和参与客户判断；它是信号，不能当作代表性调查或开发承诺。建议指定团队成员检查新内容并解释决定。这是评估建议，不是已观察到的客户成果。

sections.title_en: Missing feedback can be waiting for review
sections.title_zh: 反馈未显示时先检查审核队列
sections.en:
New projects enable moderation of public feedback and comments by default, but project settings can change what enters the Inbox or disable moderation. The Inbox identifies the contributor and collection channel. Votes and comments can be approved or rejected there; a feedback item opens a separate review where its title and description can be edited before approval.

When evaluating visibility, inspect moderation settings before treating a submission as lost. Test a non-team participant and check the public view after approval. Keep enough context when editing a request to avoid changing its meaning.
sections.zh:
新项目默认审核公众反馈和评论，但项目设置可以改变哪些内容进入 Inbox，也可以关闭审核。Inbox 显示提交人和收集渠道；投票及评论可在此批准或拒绝，反馈项则进入单独审阅页面，批准前可修改标题和描述。

评估可见性时，应先检查审核设置，再判断提交是否丢失。建议用非团队参与者提交，并在批准后检查公开视图。编辑请求时应保留足够背景，避免改变原意。

sections.title_en: A status change controls roadmap visibility
sections.title_zh: 状态变化控制路线图可见性
sections.en:
Feedback begins as Open. Moving it to Planned, In Progress or Complete places it in the corresponding roadmap column; an empty new roadmap therefore does not necessarily mean requests are missing.

For the export example, use Planned only after a product decision and Complete only after the release is actually available. These states communicate a team’s decision; they do not independently check code or deployment. Keep internal execution evidence in the team’s delivery system and use the portal to communicate the resulting status.
sections.zh:
反馈初始状态为 Open。移到 Planned、In Progress 或 Complete 后，会出现在相应路线图列中；因此新路线图为空不一定意味着请求缺失。

对于导出请求，应在产品决定后使用 Planned，真正可用后再使用 Complete。这些状态表达团队决定，不会独立核查代码或部署。建议在团队交付系统保留执行证据，再通过门户沟通相应状态。

sections.title_en: Review publication timing separately from delivery
sections.title_zh: 单独核对公告时间与实际交付
sections.en:
The changelog editor supports Markdown, a draft switch and a publication date that may be future-dated or backdated. It offers labels for fixes, new features and announcements. Saved drafts are visible to the author rather than portal users; published posts are public where the module is enabled.

Preview an announcement containing the change, its availability conditions and a link to instructions. Check the time setting and public view before relying on it for a coordinated release. A dated post alone does not establish when a feature became usable.
sections.zh:
变更日志编辑器支持 Markdown、草稿开关，以及未来或过去的发布时间，并提供修复、新功能和公告标签。保存的草稿仅作者可见，启用模块的门户会公开已发布内容。

建议预览一篇说明变化、可用条件和操作文档链接的公告。在用它协调发布前，核对时间设置与公开视图。带日期的文章本身不能证明功能何时实际可用。

sections.title_zh: 客户 SSO 需要应用端接入
sections.en:
The SSO guide calls for a secret and app ID, a server-generated HMAC using the user ID and email, and the JavaScript SDK to establish a portal session. Simply linking the portal is not this integration.

A pilot should check the intended signed-in user and the behavior when the application session is absent. Keep the secret server-side and validate current SDK behavior before production use. The homepage also lists Slack notifications, Intercom feedback collection and Zapier triggers, but their live delivery, quotas and failure recovery were not tested.
sections.zh:
SSO 指南要求取得 secret 和 app ID，在服务器上使用用户 ID 与邮箱生成 HMAC，再由 JavaScript SDK 建立门户会话。仅放置门户链接并不等于完成该集成。

试点应检查已登录时的目标用户，以及应用会话缺失时的行为。secret 应留在服务器端，上线前需验证当前 SDK 行为。官网还列出 Slack 通知、Intercom 反馈收集和 Zapier 触发器，但本次未测试实际投递、额度或失败恢复。

sections.title_en: The public pricing sources do not fully agree
sections.title_zh: 公开计费来源并不完全一致
sections.en:
The returned pricing page advertises USD49 per month after a fifteen-day trial, no card for the trial, all available features and monthly cancellation. Its reader crawl is old, so this is not a confirmed checkout quote.

The help guide instead describes paid plans based on active users. It counts commenting, voting and submitting feedback, including through integrations, while signup or SSO-created users with no interaction do not count. The pricing page also defines activity but does not explain how it affects the stated flat amount. Confirm the applicable meter, limits and taxes with the vendor; no normalized price or ongoing free plan is asserted.
sections.zh:
读取到的定价页宣传十五天试用后每月 49 美元，试用无需信用卡，包含全部可用功能并按月取消。阅读器抓取较旧，因此不能当作已确认的结账报价。

帮助指南则称付费套餐基于活跃用户：评论、投票或提交反馈（包括通过集成）计为活跃，仅注册或通过 SSO 创建但没有互动的用户不计入。定价页也定义活跃，但没有解释其如何影响标出的固定金额。应向厂商确认适用计量、额度和税费，本文不提供归一化价格，也不确认持续免费套餐。

sections.title_zh: 取消前先确认数据保留
sections.en:
The terms say uploaded material remains the user’s intellectual property and accounts use individual logins. They describe the service as provided as-is; they do not establish an open-source or self-hosting license.

Cancellation wording needs clarification: one clause says content is deleted immediately on cancellation and cannot be recovered, while another says cancellation takes effect at the subscription period’s end. Verify the applicable deletion timing and export process before an exit. This review did not cancel an account, export data or verify recovery.
sections.zh:
条款说明上传材料的知识产权仍属于用户，账户使用个人登录，并按现状提供服务。这些条款不能确立开源或自托管许可。

取消措辞需要澄清：一处称取消时内容立即删除且不可恢复，另一处称取消在订阅周期结束时生效。退出前应确认适用删除时间与导出流程。本次没有取消账户、导出数据或验证恢复。

seo.title_en: Suggested, Formerly Makerkit: Feedback, Roadmap and Pricing Boundaries
seo.title_zh: Suggested（原 Makerkit）：反馈、路线图与计费边界
seo.description_en: Official rebrand, moderation, roadmap states, changelog and unresolved pricing conditions for Suggested customer feedback.
seo.description_zh: 依据官方更名记录理解 Suggested 的反馈审核、路线图状态、变更日志及未解决的计费条件。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate a customer feedback communication loop.
secondary_questions: Why is a request absent from the roadmap?
How is an active user counted?
seo.query_basis: Editorial intent hypotheses; no measured search volume or ranking.

research_gaps.en: No account, portal, SDK, connector, export or recovery test. Current checkout, activity limits, tax, cancellation/deletion timing and service availability require confirmation.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试账户、门户、SDK、连接器、导出或恢复。当前结账、活跃额度、税费、取消／删除时间和服务可用性仍需确认。

research_gaps.en: Interface languages, regions, hosting responsibilities and source-code license were not established. Official rebrand page has no date used in this profile.
research_gaps.zh: 未确立界面语言、地区、托管责任和源码许可。本文未使用官方更名页推断日期。
